name: Djerba Golf Club
description: Djerba Golf Club is located in the heart of the island’s tourist area (at the south-eastern of Tunisia), close to the region’s finest hotels. The course is environmentally friendly and preserves natural resources, as it is irrigated with treated and recycled water. Designed by the English architect Martin Hawtree (with slight modifications), Djerba Golf Club is a 27-hole course made up of three 9-hole courses, each with its own identity and style. These allow for three different 18-hole combinations, in addition to the three 9-hole courses played individually. The greens have been completely renovated using a new grass variety. The short-game practice areas offer six greens dedicated to pitching, chipping, and putting, in addition to a 3-hectare driving range with two large platforms. The Golf Academy is open to both experienced players and beginners. In 2015, the Clubhouse underwent a complete renovation, including the building and the Bar-Restaurant, with a panoramic terrace.
